name: stat
algorithm: the facts of one existing file (the generated input), n times, through each standard library's stat call that follows links (Mk fs.Stat, Go os.Stat, Rust fs::metadata, Zig Dir.statFile, C GetFileAttributesExW or stat(2)); sum adds each answer's size; prints n, sum and the failed calls (tests/bench-lanes/rt-io2/README.md).

skip.mk-wrap: the checksum adds sizes that cannot overflow; the task has no arithmetic to wrap

no_counts: B24 does not apply: an idiomatic row compares libraries; each call's answer is checked by the size sum
notes: Written by rt-io2 (std/sys/STATUS.md, M6 session 7) for G-RTIO2-17: Mk runs a stat on its blocking pool (plan/18-runtime.md 4.11), the others on the calling thread, so the row measures the pool's round trip against a plain system call.
Not published: no number here is a measurement until tools/bench publish runs it under the machine lock.
